source_profiles.notes: Candidate profile only; no numeric feed acceptance limits are set until local batches and analytical methods are admitted.
Literature identifies surfactants, sodium and boron as important laundry-related treatment/irrigation concerns; this stream is not accepted by the initial baseline.
Higher grease/food-solid and organic loading require a separately designed profile.

candidate_trains.notes: Industrial laundry studies support only a separately scoped experimental challenge. EC alone is not admitted as a finished reuse train; a downstream barrier and source-specific quality assessment remain mandatory.

nonclaims: no treatment train is selected or qualified
no microbiological or potable safety claim
no occupied use or household installation
no municipal approval or discharge authorization
